description: Domain-partitioned variant of Linha Fina: intents are grouped by skill_id into per-skill SVM engines held in one DomainIntentEngine per language; inference runs every per-skill engine in parallel and returns the global argmax. Same distribution and confidence gate as linha-fina-medium, registered under a separate opm.pipeline entry point (DomainLinhaFinaPipeline in linha_fina/opm.py).
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate; the per-plugin config pins the same documented thresholds as linha-fina-medium. This variant is parallel (every domain engine scores, then argmax), not gated two-stage routing like the hierarchical variant — hypothesis: should improve precision over the flat pipeline on large multi-domain intent sets by keeping decision boundaries local to each skill's vocabulary, and be roughly neutral on small single-domain sets. KNOWN BROKEN as of linha-fina 0.3.0a1: LinhaFinaPipeline.handle_initial_train (linha_fina/opm.py:138) calls self.containers[lang].train(), but DomainLinhaFinaPipeline's containers are DomainIntentEngine instances which have no .train() method (AttributeError on 'mycroft.ready') -- confirmed by a live train/match sanity run in this PR. Needs an upstream fix in linha-fina before this fighter can produce real predictions; kept in the registry so a fix is picked up automatically.
